outcome: choroid plexus area-to-fetal head area ratio
cohort: A total of 10 fetuses with isolated open spina bifida and 358 structurally normal fetuses attending for aneuploidy screening, all between 11 0/7 and 13 6/7 weeks of gestation.
finding: At 11 0/7 to 13 6/7 weeks of gestation, open spina bifida is associated with a reduced amount of fluid in the fetal lateral cerebral ventricles, indicated by significantly increased choroid plexus-to-ventricle ratios.
